rows.label: tlk70000017_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Oh, hello, you lot! I thank you
again for your invaluable assistance
with my previous inventions.

rows.label: tlk70000017_01_msg0002
rows.name:
You may remember me saying before,
but the parts you can find here differ
greatly than those found in Gula.

rows.label: tlk70000017_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Mechanical parts also come in
different levels of quality.

rows.label: tlk70000017_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Apparently, gold-colored machine parts
yield higher-quality parts than
silver-colored ones!
